verdict.rationale: Cooley's own IP litigation page describes patent litigation volume across named venues: Federal Circuit appeals, patent trials, PTAB proceedings and Section 337 ITC investigations. Its labor and employment page also states it successfully represents clients in trade secret litigation. Missing for 10: specific case outcomes or win rates, any evidence of trademark litigation (the trademark page covers brand protection, not disputes), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm litigates IP disputes — patent, trademark, or trade-secret — with courts, venues, or outcomes described on its own pages

citations.quote: Since 2019 we have handled 575+ patent cases, 80+ Federal Circuit patent appeals – with the vast majority as the appellee – and 13 patent trials
475+ Patent Trial and Appeal Board (PTAB) proceedings ... 30+ Section 337 US International Trade Commission (ITC) investigations
Successfully representing companies and individuals in noncompete and trade secret litigation – and pursuing such claims for our clients
